policy: Run a bounded seed and real-project pilot, reject overlap and unsafe supply chains, and keep heavy tools opt-in; numeric aggregate scores are prohibited.

candidates.name: Knip
reason: unused-file seed was detected
default project scan reported 246 issue-bearing files and 219 unused files
agent skills, generated adapters, CLI entrypoints, and Vitest/Vite configuration produced excessive unreviewed noise

pilot.false_positive_assessment: Too noisy for a safe gate; no files may be deleted from this output alone.

functional_fit.solves_required_problem: Finds unused files, dependencies, exports, and types.
functional_fit.unnecessary_features: Whole-repository entrypoint inference exceeds the current targeted need.

project_fit.integration_surface: Would require extensive entrypoint and ignore maintenance.
project_fit.architecture_alignment: Must be reconciled with Graphify and generated-host ownership before enforcement.

maturity.tests: Seed and default real scan completed.

security.supply_chain_risk: Thirteen direct dependencies and a dev-only tree.

ownership.exit_strategy: Remain deferred and revisit with a Graphify-derived entrypoint contract.

engineering_cost.custom_build_cost: No custom unused-code engine is justified.
engineering_cost.long_term_maintenance_cost: Unclear until entrypoint policy is canonical.

candidates.name: fast-check
reason: 200 deterministic property runs exercise exact-payload integrity and proof-age boundaries
a one-dependency package adds security-relevant cases ordinary examples miss
seed and shrink behavior are reproducible

pilot.seeded_defect: tampered signed payload and max-age off-by-one
pilot.false_positive_assessment: No false positives; fixed seed makes failures reproducible.

functional_fit.solves_required_problem: Generates and shrinks authorization, idempotency, and state-boundary cases.
functional_fit.unnecessary_features: Only the core runner is used.

project_fit.compatible_with_current_stack: Works directly with Vitest and TypeScript.
project_fit.integration_surface: One exact dev dependency and one property test.
project_fit.architecture_alignment: Strengthens existing tests without a new framework.

maturity.documentation_quality: Strong official docs and Context7 coverage.

ownership.lock_in: Low; properties are plain Vitest tests.
ownership.exit_strategy: Replace generated cases with equivalent deterministic fixtures.

operations.observability: Seed, counterexample, and shrink path on failure.

engineering_cost.custom_build_cost: Custom generators and shrinkers would be worse.

agent_fit.deterministic_testability: Yes with explicit seed and numRuns.

candidates.name: StrykerJS
reason: 83 targeted mutants exposed 23 surviving and two uncovered proof-path mutations
69.88 percent all-mutant score revealed test weakness hidden by passing coverage
retained only as a selective critical-module command, never every commit

pilot.seeded_defect: mutations in signed lead-intake proof logic
pilot.false_positive_assessment: Survivors are concrete test gaps; multi-minute runtime limits use to selected critical modules.

functional_fit.solves_required_problem: Measures whether tests kill plausible code faults.
functional_fit.unnecessary_features: Dashboard and broad mutation modes are disabled.

project_fit.compatible_with_current_stack: Official Vitest runner supports the repository.
project_fit.integration_surface: Two exact dev dependencies, one targeted config, one opt-in command.
project_fit.architecture_alignment: Grades test strength rather than test count.

maturity.documentation_quality: Official config schema and troubleshooting docs.
maturity.tests: Full dry run plus 83 targeted mutants.

security.security_history: Nested qs advisory was removed with a compatible 6.15.3 override; npm audit is clean.
security.permissions_required: Local source instrumentation and test execution.
security.supply_chain_risk: Large dev-only dependency tree, bounded by selective use and audit.

ownership.dependency_depth: High: roughly 145 packages added in the pilot.
ownership.upgrade_cost: High; rerun the critical-module pilot and audit.
ownership.lock_in: Low report-schema lock-in, moderate runner config coupling.
ownership.exit_strategy: Remove packages/config while retaining discovered regression tests.

operations.observability: Per-mutant status, location, killing test, and JSON report.

engineering_cost.adaptation_cost: Small config; alias discovery required vitest.related=false.
engineering_cost.custom_build_cost: A custom mutation engine is irrational.
engineering_cost.long_term_maintenance_cost: Moderate to high; justified only on critical modules.

agent_fit.deterministic_testability: Mostly; mutants and exact config are fixed.

candidates.name: ast-grep
reason: AST pattern matched all four nullish-coalescing normalization sites without regex
only two packages were added and npm audit remained clean
kept as an on-demand structural query/codemod tool after Graphify identifies scope

pilot.false_positive_assessment: Exact TypeScript AST matches only; no repository-wide gate is added.

project_fit.integration_surface: One exact dev dependency and command.
project_fit.architecture_alignment: Graphify locates blast radius; ast-grep performs exact structural work.

maturity.tests: Seed plus four real AST matches.

security.permissions_required: Read-only unless an explicit rewrite is requested.
security.supply_chain_risk: Two packages; install script remains explicitly denied because the platform binary works without it.

ownership.upgrade_cost: Rerun AST seed and exact match.
ownership.exit_strategy: Remove dependency and keep source unchanged.

engineering_cost.custom_build_cost: Custom TypeScript AST rewrites cost more.

candidates.name: Semgrep Community
reason: two caller-controlled identity rules caught both seeded violations
115 real TypeScript files produced zero findings and zero scan errors
scheduled/security-PR use justifies its higher startup cost

pilot.seeded_defect: organization and role destructured from request JSON
pilot.false_positive_assessment: Zero findings on the current application and Convex source.

functional_fit.unnecessary_features: Cloud platform and Pro engine are unused.

project_fit.compatible_with_current_stack: Current CLI supports TypeScript on Windows and CI Linux.
project_fit.integration_surface: Pinned uvx environment, one YAML config, one wrapper.
project_fit.architecture_alignment: Enforces server-context identity invariants without replacing tests.

maturity.documentation_quality: Official rule and CLI docs with Context7 coverage.

security.security_history: No project audit dependency because uvx isolates the pinned CLI.
security.secret_handling: No account or token; metrics disabled.
security.network_access: Package acquisition on cold start only.
security.supply_chain_risk: Sixty-seven isolated Python packages and a 54.8 MB CLI package.

ownership.license: LGPL-2.1 for the open engine; rules are project-owned.
ownership.dependency_depth: High but isolated outside npm runtime.
ownership.upgrade_cost: Rerun seed, real scan, and review rule semantics.
ownership.exit_strategy: Remove wrapper/config and retain equivalent deterministic tests.

operations.runtime_cost: About 61.5 seconds on Windows real scan.
operations.observability: JSON findings, errors, scanned paths, and skipped rules.

engineering_cost.custom_build_cost: Custom semantic parsing would be weaker.
engineering_cost.long_term_maintenance_cost: Moderate; run in security workflow, not every edit.

candidates.name: Lighthouse CI
reason: exact install added 251 packages
npm audit immediately reported 10 vulnerabilities including seven high-severity paths
Playwright plus axe already supplies safer browser, console, and accessibility evidence

pilot.runtime_test_skipped: Security hard stop tripped before browser execution.
pilot.false_positive_assessment: Audit paths were concrete vulnerable transitive dependencies.

functional_fit.solves_required_problem: Can assert Lighthouse audits and categories.

project_fit.integration_surface: Very large dependency tree and duplicate browser orchestration.
project_fit.architecture_alignment: Overlaps adopted Playwright/axe and violates the clean-audit bar.

maturity.maintenance_activity: Maintained but dependency fixes lag current advisories.

security.security_history: Seven high, one moderate, and two low audit findings in the exact release tree.
security.secret_handling: No secrets required for local mode.

ownership.upgrade_cost: High and currently cannot clear audit without incompatible changes.

operations.runtime_cost: Not measured after the hard stop.
operations.observability: Rich reports, but not enough to outweigh risk.

engineering_cost.custom_build_cost: No custom Lighthouse replacement is planned.

candidates.name: OSV-Scanner
reason: detected three vulnerability groups in a seeded lodash lockfile
scanned 909 real packages with zero findings in two seconds
independent OSV intelligence complements npm audit

pilot.false_positive_assessment: Seed advisories map to authoritative OSV/GHSA records; real lockfile was clean.

functional_fit.unnecessary_features: Container, remediation, and license modes are unused.

project_fit.integration_surface: One digest-pinned standalone binary and wrapper.
project_fit.architecture_alignment: Complements existing npm audit without replacing it.

maturity.documentation_quality: Official usage, output, and supported-artifact docs.
maturity.tests: Vulnerable seed and full real lockfile.

security.security_history: Release digest verified; upstream publishes SLSA provenance.
security.network_access: Advisory lookup plus first binary download.

ownership.upgrade_cost: Refresh asset digests and rerun seed/real scan.
ownership.exit_strategy: Remove wrapper/manifest and retain npm audit.

operations.runtime_cost: About two seconds on the real lockfile.
operations.hosted_service_required: OSV advisory service unless offline database mode is selected.
operations.observability: Structured package, group, alias, severity, and source output.

agent_fit.deterministic_testability: Seed is deterministic; online advisories are time-sensitive by design.

candidates.name: Gitleaks
reason: synthetic generic API-key canary was detected and redacted
origin/dev-to-HEAD branch scan found zero leaks across 13 commits
scope avoids 102 ignored-artifact findings and five historical test-placeholder findings

pilot.seeded_defect: synthetic generic API key over stdin
pilot.false_positive_assessment: Branch-range mode eliminates ignored dependency artifacts and pre-existing test placeholders while still scanning every candidate commit.

functional_fit.solves_required_problem: Detects secret-like material in candidate commits.
functional_fit.unnecessary_features: Full filesystem and all-history scans are intentionally not gated.

project_fit.integration_surface: One digest-pinned binary and exact branch-range wrapper.
project_fit.architecture_alignment: Strengthens current hooks without contacting credential providers.

maturity.maintenance_activity: Feature-complete with security maintenance; upstream development is shifting to Betterleaks.
maturity.tests: Redacted stdin seed, branch range, naive directory, and full history comparison.

security.security_history: No pilot issue; release digest verified.
security.secret_handling: Reports are forced to 100 percent redaction.

ownership.upgrade_cost: Refresh digest and rerun scope/noise tests.
ownership.exit_strategy: Replace with a proven Betterleaks pilot if it materially improves signal.

operations.observability: Rule, file, line, fingerprint, commit, and redacted match.

engineering_cost.custom_build_cost: Current homemade patterns cannot match the maintained rule corpus.

agent_fit.deterministic_testability: Yes for fixed commits and stdin seeds.

candidates.name: k6
reason: local-only five-VU pilot completed 160 invalid lead submissions with 100 percent checks
p95 was 159.35 ms and no request was classified failed after current expected-status semantics were applied
non-local base URLs are denied before any request

pilot.seeded_defect: external target plus intentional 400 response classification
pilot.false_positive_assessment: First run exposed harness semantics; current Context7-grounded expectedStatuses contract is stable.

functional_fit.solves_required_problem: Concurrent API and validation-path load checks.
functional_fit.unnecessary_features: Cloud output and heavy load profiles are disabled.

project_fit.integration_surface: One digest-pinned binary, local server wrapper, and script.
project_fit.architecture_alignment: Opt-in pre-release evidence; not an every-commit service.

maturity.tests: Local validation load and external-target denial.

security.security_history: No pilot issue; release digest verified.
security.permissions_required: Local HTTP only in the committed script.
security.network_access: Loopback only; code rejects other origins.

ownership.upgrade_cost: Refresh digest and rerun safe-local and denial tests.
ownership.exit_strategy: Remove binary/script and retain integration tests.

operations.runtime_cost: About 16 seconds including local server startup; 5.4-second load window.
operations.observability: Rates, percentiles, checks, iterations, and threshold status.

engineering_cost.custom_build_cost: Custom load generation/metrics would be weaker.

agent_fit.deterministic_testability: Thresholds are deterministic; timing remains environment-sensitive and deliberately reported.
